data.name: Itee
data.long_meaning: Itee is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess Ishani, the goddess of motherhood and fertility. In Hindu mythology, Ishani is often depicted as a nurturing mother, holding her child in her arms. This name is believed to bring blessings of a healthy and happy child to new parents.
